text: We loved this place. I advise getting there early if you don't want to wait because it gets crowded. They don't take reservations but they do have a wait list- Yelp will tell you how long the wait is and will remind you when to put your name on the list in order to eat at a specific time. The pizza was really good- crispy crust snd delicious toppings - I ate a whole 12 inch pie by myself. The servers were very attentive- we had a young child with us and they made sure she was taken care of. We are from NY so can't come here often but next time we're in town, we'll be back.
EVERYTHING is well priced and tastes delish. The friendly and helpful staff helped this non spanish speaking guy out a lot. I will be back... weekly!

Decent, not great breakfast. Service was excellent though. The waiter, working the graveyard shift, was impressive the way he was hustling about and the manner in which he dealt with the numerous drunks. I'm an early riser, but was surrounded by people that hadn't turned in from the night before yet. Obviously these people took away from the ambieance, being a bit boisterious and obnoxious.
Fantastic pizza and pasta. Christino's is my go to place when we visit my family back in Clearwater. Love their ravioli. I can not recommend them enough...well done.

After struggling to agree on where to go for a late Valentine's Day dinner, I let my partner decide where to eat and we ended up making a reservation here. I'll be the first to say that brazilian steakhouses were not my favorite. I've been to Rodizio and Fogo and I thought they were okay but not mindblowing. My experience here at Picanha was probably my first full 10/10 experience at a restaurant. The atmosphere is very chill. It was decorated very nicely, but not over the top where it felt TOO fancy. We got there at 5:30 with a reservation that felt unneeded because it was almost empty when we got there. But within the hour it quickly got packed so good thing we got there when we did. The service is what probably made me give the full 5 stars. Our server provided us with excellent service, he was very relaxed and chill, and always tended to our needs (even when we didn't know what we needed) it was the little things that made him stand out more than any other server I've had at other restaurants. He would come by often and offer a clean plate, fold our napkins when we left the table, and pour our wine glasses when it was looking a little too empty. Okay I ranted enough, now let's talk about FOOD. The buffet-styled appetizer bar? (i don't know what to call if i'm sorry i'm new to this LOL) had a lot of choices from salads to charcuterie, to pasta, chicken wings, sea food, mashed potatoes, and a bunch of other stuff I probably should have tried. I tend to not eat a lot from th

I'm so glad this place is open during COVID! I was craving something sweet and always heard of the beignets from the vintage! Hard to pick one flavor and they have a choice of the 3 flights! So I went with strawberry, blueberry cheese cake, and matcha. You know that feeling of eating something that reminds you of a great childhood moment! That's what happen with this amazing stuffed beignets! Literally and amazing pop tart or toaster strudel! You can't go wrong with going here for something sweet and the price was amazing! Will be returning soon! Also amazing staff and appreciate this place for being open!

I typically avoid the chain restaurants, but their Tuesday $5 craft burger special lured me from my bunker mid-pandemic.  My whole group agreed this burger/fries combo was far superior to other joints that offer similar early-week specials.
I'm so mad. I only come here for one specific item I'm craving and when I get home, the food is a waste, the can is rotted, and food is spoiled! It's a expensive too! Not willing to come back again

Just WOW! We like to do foodie road trips (small plates from numerous restaurants) and included this on our recent tour. We ordered the chicken sate and cheese rolls. 
The chicken was AMAZING! Grilled kabob style with a coating that reminded me of massaman curry. A peanut dipping sauce and side salad with an fantastic honey dressing was also included. The meat was so tender and the sauces just wow! The cheese rolls were a soft cheese, unlike say a mozzarella stick, with such an amazing flavor and texture. They're deep fried and were super hot (temp), so be careful. They, too, came with a dipping sauce. Just an incredible experience. We will return for the full menu at a later time. Friendly service

A wonderful upgrade to our Cleveland Street restaurant scene.  Now we have an actual Sports bar and restaurant we can walk to, hang out, eat great food, and imbibe to our hearts desires.

Owners are local, super friendly and truly care what is happening in and around our community.   

When you want to relax with your family or friends, chill out or watch a game - you can't miss here.

We've eaten here several times and have only had very good food and good service. The menu has lots of tasty offerings for a variety of palates and culinary requirements. We have always left happy. 

From seafood to veg dishes, Mediterranean, seafood, and meatier fare. Large dog friendly shaded patio area olin back and lovely well decorated interior with tables and bar area. 

This is a first rate spot in Hyde Park Village. Very fair prices for high quality and accomodating service.

Very disappointed..went her last year when I was in town was awesome, recommended it to everyone headed this way. Went back last night and it was terrible.  The light and fluffy cornbread appetizer was burnt on the bottom and hard as a rock..the menu says expect a 15 minute wait for it's cooked fresh...um Nope it was out in less than 5..the entrees were okay...but my chicken sandwich bun was again hard and crusty. Then we asked for dessert selection and were told of this Atrawberry gooey cake...yes please!! Um...no thank you as it has NO strawberries..not in it...on top nothing.  And when we mentioned it to the waitress...she snotty response was "well they are cooked in it".  Our waitress came to our table 4times..to take our order...bring our food and dessert and then the check.  I am so saddened by this visit especially after telling people how great it was last year...will NOT go back and will tell people to steer
 Clear from now on

Went there this afternoon and chose to stick to what I always order and was disappointed with the non juicy dry spicy piri piri chicken sandwich..this was not how it was served a year ago.. the gulf shrimp hushpuppies were nice and so were the meat balls and veggie hummus but the main star Spicy piri piri was not at all upto the mark this visit!

India Garden is the nicest Indian buffet in town. Not only is it good, it's cheap! I would eat there all the time for lunch but then none of my clothes would fit. Regular naan and deep fried naan. There is always a good variety in the buffet with chicken makhani being the star. I've also been for dinner with family and had the same excellent food and attentive service. Highly recommend for newbies to Indian food. The restaurant is owned by a nice family that you'll see there everyday!

This restaurant is excellent. We have come twice and both times, the BBQ was really good. We have had turkey, pulled pork, and brisket. All their meats have been of high quality and delicious --nice smoky flavor. They have a nice patio for eating and relaxing. The employees are friendly and the prices are very reasonable. We will return as this is some of the best BBQ we have had.

The food was oh so delicious and the portions were huge.... first time in for brunch and I was not disappointed.  I went with the chicken and waffles.  The seasoning was perfection...  (I have had lunch there as well and that was delicious as well)
Best Chargrilled Oyster !!!! We came to this place just to try the oyster  when we are in a vacation from NJ ..loved it and can't wait to comeback again !!!
I never ordered from Five Guys before. The two ladies working the register helped me figure out what to order and were so great! Kenya and Jakeira! The food is good too! Thanks

Decided to try this place because Italian and seafood, why not? Well, after pulling up to the front door, we were slightly wondering about the recommendations. It looked so old but often these places are the best places in my experience. This one did not disappoint! Once inside,  the staff is overwhelmingly kind and courteous. We felt like we were an audience of one! Seating was upstairs and incredibly full of character. The culture oozing from the beautiful paintings, eclectic decor, and the ambiance was welcome. You can peruse Adolfo cooking up your choices. 
We ordered the steak bruschetta as an appetizer. Wow! The steak was cooked to perfection in a happy medium of the tomatoes and garlic sauce. Next, our party ordered pasta with the ocean sauce (a site creation and must not miss!), the steak, grouper, and more pasta! Everything was perfect and exceeded our expectations for sure! The sauces were truly the talk of our table.
 Staff was super attentive and rolled out the Southern charm at every turn. Plus, the bloody Mary's were fantastic. This place is a must visit when you come to New Orleans!

Wow, never have I experienced such rude customer service! 

Placed our order online at 6:59pm and when we patiently and politely called to check on it 2.5 HOURS LATER, the first employee that picked up had a terrible attitude. She had no idea what was going on, spending 15 minutes looking up our order on their system and then HUNG UP ON US.. When we called back, another employee picked up and replied with, "uh, yeah, it's out on delivery. I only have one driver tonight" and then hung up! No simple acknowledgement of their lack of competency!

There's no option to even cancel the order so we were trapped with proceeding with it. Pizza got delivered at 10:47pm. INSANE - almost 4 hours later.

The pizza itself was at room temperature of course. Wow do not order from this location. Please save yourself from the unnecessary ill treatment and stress.
This place is amazing, I travel all over the country for work and I love good seafood. This seriously good food!!!

Delicious!  Stopped into this place on a whim and am very pleasantly surprised.  I'm sad that for a Brandonite I have overlooked it for so long.  The pizza is delicious, beer is cold and staff is friendly.  Will definitely come back!

Went with two other couples for Mothers Day dinner. We were seated at our reservation time and drink orders were taken right away.
The food was very good and ample. Our server, Jessica, made the whole night enjoyable because she was attentive, professional and very nice to deal with.

I have never been a PF Chang's fan but this experience changed my mind and we will go back.

The view was good (and similar to one I had just seen from a hospital room), the food was good (restaurant week portions) but be careful with the service....the reservation requires a deposit which is kinda unusual but the worse part was our waiter decided to double his tip.  We had a gift card and told him to give himself a $40 tip but he decided to process it as $80 and then we were given the balance on our gift card.  Had the balance on our GC not be checked by me, he would have made $80. Luckily we caught it and now have a major sour taste for this place.  Someone fixed it for us but the waiter never can back to apologize sohis tail must have been caught between his legs.  Buyer beware.
I had a good time overall the food was good, atmosphere is good for date nite. I would not go back though
This review is only for thier pita falaffel wrap.  The pitta was too dry/hard and the falafel was far from fresh. I would not go here again for a mediterranean wrap.

This might be one of the most delightful businesses I have ever been to! Firstly it's pink. I could probably end the review there. 

Everything about this process was awesome! It is a completely personalized and service focused drive thru. Pulling up behind the building you will be greeted by a human, not a voice box. The gal was friendly, helpful, answered all the questions and indulged me in some banter. 

Things I love: 
The branding is ADORABLE 
Toasts are served on Gulfcoast Sourdough 
Seasonal drinks with house made syrup 
Fast service 

This business is pretty much a no brainer. I can't find a flaw.

What to know:
- Very affordable menu: Most appetizers are $10-15 and entrees are $25-30. However, they are currently offering $30 and $50 prix fixe options that include 1 app, 1 entree, and 1 dessert (price difference depends on whether your entree was more than $30).
- BIG portions: Gf and I each did the prix fixe menu and had leftovers to bring home!
- Maybe it was just our amazing waitress Christine but we were able to substitute one of the desserts with an extra appetizer
- BYOB

What to get:
- Caesar Salad: A classic done right with homemade Caesar dressing!
- Lobster Bisque: Currently a special but perfect for a chilly night! Does not have actual lobster chunks though FYI
- Ribeye Steak: Juicy steak with a surprising Gorgonzola balsamic glaze and mash potatoes. Delish!
- Nutella cannoli: Doesn't get any better than this

What to avoid:
- Frutti di Mare: Came with a ton of seafood which was amazing but the pasta itself was unseasoned and pretty dry.
- Prosciutto Wrapped Dates: Not what I expected. The dates are huge and the prosciutto is crisped. If you're expecting Spanish tapas-style (as I did), you will be disappointed.

All in all, great local dinner spot with a well-priced prix fixe menu (and you can save money on drinks with the BYOB)

This is the best juice place in the northwest (better than Seattle and Portland places even) but one thing I would love to see is a "weekly rotational" juice. I'm sure the staff are back there mixing up their own favorites anyway maybe you could let them put a weekly rotational out every Monday for us avid fans that go there 1-2x per week

Hello everyone, 
I would like you all to know that Flamestones is back open and they have ALL new furniture and decor and most importantly noted, are all set up for fine dining at a distance inside. I visited last night and was soo happy to see my friends Nichola tossin up the fine Liquor and wine behind the bar, Allison serving up the best service at my table and Emil running around over seeing everything from the front of the house to the back so to speak.I had STONE OVEN FLATBREAD WITH STEAK & BLUE CHEESE which was nothing less than Awesome along with a cocktail (or two) from Nick. PLEASE GO and experience yourself. Tell them BOSTON TODD sent ya !

This place is delicious! They are so caring and kind, especially Adam, he's the best!! They are open through all of this and are doing all they can to help their community. I had the smoked wings which were fabulous!  I can tell they go to extensive measures to give the best service around.

Waited over 45 minutes for a pizza they never started the order
Staff very rude
Did get a cash refund even though I wanted it on my card
Will never return

We love this little cupcake shop!! They have so many different cupcake flavors to choose from. They have great weekly specials too. I still need to try their ice cream! It's a place you can go for fun with the kids for a sweet treat!

While working near the SB area I wanted to try something different from what I normally would eat such as Mexican, American, Asian, or Italian food.  I stepped out of my comfort zone and went for some Caribbean food.  Boy, am I happy with the choice that I made. The food was absolutely delicious! 
I went during the pandemic so dining was outdoors which I didn't mind at all. I had to wait for about 25 mins for a table but I didn't mind. The weather was nice and warm in the early evening. In fact, while waiting for my table I was jamming to the one man band musician that plays the steel drums beautifully and has a great voice too. I finally was seated and my waiter Jockco was more than gracious and accommodating. He took my order and brought my wine and water out Immediately. The Jerk Chicken I ordered took about 25-30 mins. Typically, I'd be frustrated by the long wait, but do to COVID-19 I understand that things are moving at a much slower pace, so I just patiently waited.
When my food finally arrived it smelled delicious. The presentation looked like a magazine ad. When I took my first bite of my meal I knew I had made the right choice on this restaurant, and know that I will come back on future visits to SB. The portions are very proper. You can save some for later if you wish. 
Overall, I had a wonderful experience. The staff was great, and I believe the owner came out to greet the patrons. A big thumbs up to this restaurant. I'm glad that I made the best choice.

Best Papa Murphy's location in the treasure valley. We had trouble ordering online a few times but Greg honored our online coupons twice. Super nice and accommodating. He puts customers first. Unlike the overland store where the girl was not helpful or nice and lacked basic customer service skills. This is our location of choice and happy it's close to our house. Thanks Greg!!! 5 stars.
Got takeout and the food was delicious as always.  The menu has changed since the last time I was here. Got the big bad wolf sandwich which was excellent.

Great spot for Vietnamese FOOD!!!Delicious rice platters ! Love the custom dessert options. Service 5 stars -highly recommend for date night . Food temp always perfect. For me -  enjoyed ALL the  rice platters & pork chops. Didn't like the BBH - pho was just ok . Service solid perfect every time. Servers are very attentive. Cleanliness full 5 stars. My 4 stars rating is base on overall experience and taste of food.

This review calls for negative stars.  First off, extremely rude and nasty male host. No greeting. No "welcome to The Columbia!" No "Hello" and certainly, no smile. No nothing except "You need a mask!!!!!!!!" 

Beware.. they are extremely worried about a virus with a survivability of only 99.97%.  Make sure you have your filthy cotton mouth covering on at all times because let me tell you, they're gonna reprimand the heck out of you if you don't. Even to stand up and drink your drink.  

We went to the bar, took off the mask as it is ok to do in Tampa and immediately the host charged over and yelled at us for taking them off (even though another couple was at the opposite end of the bar drinking WITHOUT A MASK. Funny, they were also in our party. ) Anyway, we were familiar with the Tampa mask rules but in Clearwater, you can't even stand at the bar without a mask WHILE DRINKING your beverage or you will be threatened and yelled at, at least at this overrated restaurant. You must take your drink outside.  The host was beyond rude, beyond angry and in no way professional.  The host actually physically jumped back when I asked "what?" because it was crowded and noisy and couldn't hear.  Talk about irrational hysteria. Please... get a grip or get a different job. 

The wait for seating, even with reservation, was 45 minutes delayed. Unacceptable. The wait to place orders was unbearable. The wait for drinks was inexcusable. The wait for salads to arrive was longer than normal. The

Really great atmosphere and the staff was great as well. 

We had a preset menu

A side salad, salmon and non flour chocolate cake. 

The salad had an amazing balsamic dressing that was very flavorful. 

The salmon was seasoned to perfection and vet tender and the broccoli was perfect. 

Wine list was great with some local wines that went very well with the food.

The food, especially the sushi is great. I would suggest dining in because they refuse to hire competent staff to take phone orders, most of them clearly high school students. The last couple times I ordered hibachi noodles they were bland, and they can't seem to make up their minds if the noodles come with vegetables or for an additional fee. I order from them almost weekly and this is always an issue. Other than that, some of the best sushi in town.

I pulled up to the drive thru at 8:20 pm on Sat. 1/30/2021 and the greeting was we close in 20 minutes so we are not taking anymore orders. SO, if they close at 9:00 maybe there clocks are 20 minutes fast. Drove down to Rally's and ate better and cheaper.  I told lady taking my order at Rally's about it and she was not surprised at all.  How can an owner let their employees turn away business like that? Every review I see of that place is horrible! Their site says they are open 24 hrs. I understand  with Covid-19 and crime they alter hours but not have time to fry a hamburger with at least 40 minutes left is absolutely ridiculous!
         Signed LOST CUSTOMER FOREVER
Paris culinary experience on Main Line. Bring your favorite vino and enjoy authentic French Cuisine. Delicious!

Generous portions of plant based goodness. Both my husband and I enjoyed the food here and ate on the patio. I had the tamale filled with veggies and potatoes. Very tasty.  My husband had the burger. A little messy but tastes great.

If you like fried food, this is your place! Almost everything was fried. The food was delicious to me. My daughter wasn't impressed, but she is 9 and isn't a fried food fanatic. The beans were awesome. They give you so much food, you have to pace yourself. I shared the seafood platter with my daughter and got her a kids meal. Kids meals are about the cost of the "fixings" so it was the same price. We took majority home. The waitress was very friendly and helpful. The kid even got a free ice cream after the smorgasbord. Overall a good experience for the price.

Used to love this place. They have screwed me over the past 3 times with ubereats. Wrong order or they shut down ubereats an hour and half before closing hours and then you go to order in the timeframe they have posted hours but get screwed and mostly just fast food crap available after that than. Give customers the correct hours on ubereats! Ridiculous

THE BEST ice cream. I am not a fan of vegan cheeses, milks, ice creams, and other alternatives. But Plant Love's ice cream is unlike anything I've ever had before. I PREFER it over normal ice cream. It's so much creamier, tastier, and even healthier/organic. I am obsessed with this place and always stop in whenever I'm downtown. I'll even buy pints to have on hand at home, and to support this amazing local business!

What's great about the cafe is that you don't have to worry about quick service. Was in there this afternoon at store then popped over with idea to get tea and so forth. Tall guy with white hair was able to move in and out of kitchen joking with staff while customers waited. They make enough money I guess. So much for supporting local.
Cooks not wear mask over nose, I would think someone would train of the dangers of Covid
Amazing food and atmosphere it's tucked into n a shopping center customer service is good
Ramen was very very good. All fresh ingredients and cooked to perfection. Five stars all day!
